Name: Ovosath, Quicksilver, The Young Guardian

Voice: Smaug but feminine, friendly, "I am she who is  Ovosath, I am Quicksilver, and I wish to know why you are here humans."

Description: Female Young Silver Dragon, Her scales shine like crystals, almost blinding in light areas. She has fins along her spine and webbed toes. Her eyes are piercing blue like ice, and her body is always cold to the touch.

Important Info: Guardian Dragon, ally of mortals and enemy of the Abyss. Ovosath is a friend, but is a bit strange. She wants to kill Zyrathia as her experiments are causing ambient Abyss portals to open across the Berserker peaks that she calls home. 
From Akash, daughter of an Adult Silver Dragon who followed Augustus.
